story.title: The Sleep Deposit
story.logline: A sleep-deprived student sells his REM cycles to a tech firm, only to realize he is living someone else's memories.
story.twist: The memories he experiences during the day belong to the billionaire CEO who bought his sleep.
story.ending: Whose eyes am I closing right now?

scenes.narration: I just sold eight hours of tonight's sleep for enough cash to pay my tuition.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, wearing a gray hoodie, inside a sterile clinic with glowing blue lights.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's tired eyes

scenes.narration: The nurse plugged a thick silver cable straight into the base of my skull without a warning.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, gray hoodie, flinching as a metallic cable connects to his neck.

scenes.narration: They said my brain would just take a harmless little vacation while I made easy money.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, gray hoodie, lying back on a leather medical chair, staring blankly.

scenes.narration: When I woke up, my room felt wrong. The air smelled like expensive cedar and old money.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, wearing an expensive silk robe, standing in a luxury penthouse overlooking a city.

scenes.narration: I looked down at my hands. These fingers were older, scarred from a fencing foil I never held.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, in the penthouse, holding up unfamiliar hands with a distinct gold signet ring.

scenes.narration: My phone buzzed on the marble counter. A calendar alert flashed for a corporate board meeting.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, in the penthouse, looking at a smartphone displaying a CEO schedule.

scenes.narration: I didn't rent out empty space. I rented out a vessel, and now I am trapped inside.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, staring into a massive floor-to-ceiling mirror, seeing a billionaire's reflection.

scenes.narration: Downstairs in the lobby, a security guard looked right at me and called me by the CEO's name.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, in a grand marble lobby, nodding nervously at a uniformed guard.

scenes.narration: I am funding my college degree by letting a billionaire borrow my youth while he steals my day.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, stepping into a private elevator, pressing the top floor button with shaking fingers.

scenes.narration: Tonight I go back to the clinic. But when I close my eyes, whose life am I funding?
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 19, messy dark hair, closing his eyes in the back of a luxury town car, tears catching the city lights.

caption.hook: He sold his sleep to get rich.
caption.title: The Sleep Deposit
caption.caption:
Trading restless nights for luxury seemed like a smart fix until the daytime memories weren't his own.

Would you rent out your dreams for a billion dollars?
